notes.title: Alpha test application form
notes.notes:
For the last couple of years, we have been actively working on our game The Hunt of the Blood Moon! The Hunt of the Blood Moon is a first-person murder-mystery survival horror game where 10 players work together to uncover and kill the mysterious creature while trying to survive.

We are excited to announce our first alpha test! Our game has reached the alpha state. Thus it is now time to test the gameplay! Are you a passionate gamer who loves to explore new worlds and likes to give feedback?

We will be opening the game for a short timeframe for a select amount of people! If you want to be one of the first people to play The Hunt of the Blood Moon and help us improve our game by giving valuable feedback, you can sign up via this form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeYgfwg7-j4rF0hAymRVcdTCrfqTocK0dhFAU07vMlpCzs_Gw/viewform?usp=sf_link

Make sure to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/2zxwNhhM6u
